exposure: Delivery era (before and after formalising a cardio-obstetrics program)
cohort: 25 pregnant patients with high-risk CVD who delivered in the main operating room at a large academic centre between January 2010 and March 2021
finding: Short-term outcomes of pregnant patients with high-risk CVD undergoing main OR delivery are favourable.
mod_finding: This study focused on the management and outcomes of pregnant patients with high-risk cardiovascular disease undergoing cesarean delivery in the main operating room and did not compare to other modes of delivery.
